goal: Merge overlapping intervals given as a list of [start, end] pairs
assumptions: Input is a list of intervals, where each interval is a list of exactly two integers [start, end].
An interval is considered valid if start <= end; intervals with start > end are not expected and behavior is undefined.
Overlap is inclusive: intervals that touch at a point (e.g., [1,3] and [3,5]) are merged into [1,5].
The input list may be empty; an empty list returns an empty list.
The input list may contain a single interval; it is returned unchanged.
Intervals may contain negative integers, zero, and duplicate intervals.
The output is a list of merged intervals sorted in ascending order by start time.
The function does not modify the input list.
The function returns a new list of lists of integers.

survivors: [llm] Sorts only by start, causing incorrect merge order when starts are equal but ends differ
